title: Material found buried deep in rocks at the crash site

tellings.quote: we did find things but they weren't easy to find if they were placed there they were placed so far down rocks that had been there for looked like a hundred years

plain: In 2016, at a site in New Mexico said to be where a UFO crashed, a small team found material buried deep inside rocks that looked about a hundred years old. A religious studies scholar named Diana Pasulka, who says she was there, tells Michels the things "weren't easy to find," and that if anyone had planted them they had been put very far down, which would argue against a recent plant.
